dataset.note: Analysis uses the supplied dataset. Interpretations are descriptive; the sample may not represent all customers.

bernoulli_status.interpretation: Estimated success probability is 0.445 based on observed transaction statuses.

binomial_transaction_count.note: Approximate illustrative fit: the dataset does not specify a fixed number of possible weekly transaction opportunities.

poisson_daily_transactions.note: Daily counts are aggregated from transaction dates, including zero-transaction dates within the observed date range.

pareto_power_law_amounts.note: A Pareto distribution is used as a simple power-law-style comparison; rigorous power-law inference often requires tail selection and specialized methods.

normality_shapiro.interpretation: Small p-values provide evidence against normality; use Q-Q plots alongside tests.

box_cox.note: Box-Cox was applied to positive transaction amounts only.

amount_over_5000.note: The normal-approximation probability assumes a Normal model and may be unreliable for skewed transaction amounts; compare with the empirical proportion.
